title: Generate fit-ready structures without supplying a parent
hypothesis: Bounded, phase-scaled parameters and smooth transitions make parameter perturbations behaviorally useful, increasing the success attainable by budget-matched direct rollout search on seedless generated structures.

prediction.against: the same single-phase generation prompt without the contract, under identical 24-candidate independent rollout search
prediction.rationale: Generation-block paired means give the primary interval (3 blocks); placements and search seeds are repeated measurements. Invalid slots count as zero.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (--research-mode seedless-searchability: per block one baseline and one contract structure via single-phase generation with one correction; 24-candidate independent rollout search x 2 seeds; confirm selected and original)
tests/test_two_lane_search.py or a new focused test

falsified_by: The upper 95% paired interval is below +0.10; an interval containing zero leaves a directional improvement inconclusive. Invalid generation slots count as zero, not replacement opportunities.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00024, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation

controls.note: control is the same single-phase prompt without the contract, generated in the same block and searched identically; the metric is already contract minus baseline

result.notes: Three generation blocks (3020-3022) x [baseline, contract], one structure each via single-phase gpt-6.1-sol generation (all 6 valid on the first call, no corrections); 24-candidate independent rollout search under seeds 3023/3024 on probe s3025 (10), confirmation s3026 (50). Contract minus baseline: block-level -0.293 [-0.655, +0.069]; placement-level [-0.365, -0.221]; contract worse in all three blocks. Untrained (step 0): contract minus baseline -0.240. Side observation (not the tested hypothesis; three structures only): the baseline single-phase prompt produced structures scoring 0.88, 0.16, 0.48 untrained and 0.80-1.00 after search, whereas the logs/baseline_gpt61_sol_high two-phase run reached 0.00 on its promotion set. 3730 episodes (2880 probe + 850 confirmation), 6 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: Contract minus baseline under identical 24-candidate rollout search is -0.293 at the block level [-0.655, +0.069] and [-0.365, -0.221] by placement; the upper block bound is below the predicted +0.10, which refutes, and the contract was worse in every block, both untrained and after search. The contract's constraints (unit-direction drives, specific gate ranges) produced structures that search could not repair as well as the unconstrained prompt's. Side observation: the plain single-phase prompt's three structures reached 0.16-0.88 untrained and 0.80-1.00 after search, far above the two-phase gpt-6.1-sol baseline's 0.00.
verdicts.next_experiment: Test the side observation directly: single-phase versus the two-phase ideas prompt for seedless generation, both under 24-candidate rollout search, with more blocks; if it holds, the exploration lane should switch prompts and add rollout search.

verdicts.reasoning: The specified no-contract control was measured under matched rollout search [logs/research/seedless_searchability_s3020/summary.json]. The primary generation-block paired_success_difference was -0.2933, with a 95% interval of [-0.6553, +0.0686] [logs/research/seedless_searchability_s3020/summary.json]. Its upper bound is below the predicted +0.10 improvement, satisfying the predeclared falsification condition [logs/research/seedless_searchability_s3020/summary.json]. Because the primary interval includes zero, whether the contract decreases success remains inconclusive; the narrower placement-level interval does not establish a generation-level difference [logs/research/seedless_searchability_s3020/summary.json].
